entry.summary:
Discover what a career in procurement looks like at Health New Zealand. In this video, we follow one of our procurement specialists whose journey began in nursing and aviation before moving into large-scale national health projects — including leading a billion-dollar helicopter services contract.

Health procurement is complex, fast-paced and deeply rewarding. From aeromedical services to radiotherapy machines, mattresses and patient beds, our teams help deliver the equipment and services that keep hospitals running and support care for communities across Aotearoa New Zealand.

Hear firsthand how strong partnerships, strategic procurement, and meaningful work come together to make a real difference for patients every day.

If you're looking for a career with purpose, impact and growth, join us at Health New Zealand.
